text:
ellen-sales: Quick kickoff for SolaraHealth perf validation. They want sustained 1k qps with 5k microbursts, target P95 <200ms for ~512-token responses. Need a short runbook + ballpark cost by EOD so I can send an exec summary.

devon-ps: Confirming scope: do hosted baseline + dedicated fallback for SLA. We'll run multi-az ramp and a dedicated warm-fallback scenario.

mike-eng: Notes: 512-token replies implies heavy GPU work; to hit P95<200ms we'll rely on continuous batching, KV prefix caching, and tight max-batch latency. Rough compute: hosted-sim -> emulate shared noisy env with 8 workers; dedicated -> 3 reserved nodes (A10g equivalent) as starting point.

zoe-sre: Will add multi-az network tail checks and KMS key presence. Solara asks about HSM for keys in questionnaire; harper-legal?

harper-legal: HIPAA flagged. We can provide certificate list; BAA needs sales/legal sig but not blocking the test. Call out in the summary.

mike-eng: Draft load profile: arrival=Poisson; sustained 1k qps for 30m; burst to 5k qps for 2m at minute 40; token distribution mean 400, max 512, 70% gen / 30% chat-with-reuse. Collect p50/p95/p99, gpu_util, kv_cache_hit, batch_size histograms.

perf-bot: Preliminary load config attached ->

perf-bot: ```
clients:200
arrival_model:poisson
sustained_qps:1000
burst_qps:5000
burst_window_s:120
payload: tokens_mean=400,tokens_max=512
metrics: p50,p95,p99,throughput,err_rate,gpu_util,kv_hit
routes: hosted, dedicated-fallback
failover: warm-fallback after 15s sustained err>1%
```

devon-ps: Pricing ask from Solara: per-1k token hosted + committed tier dedicated. Mike, ballpark numbers?

mike-eng: Very rough: hosted ~ $0.035 / 1k tokens at this latency target; dedicated amortized ~ $0.018 / 1k with 3 reserved nodes and good batching. With aggressive caching steady-state could be ~$0.012 / 1k. Add egress and multi-region overheads. Mark as draft.

zoe-sre: Ops tweaks: enable prefix KV cache (expect ~90% reuse on repeated prompts), set max-batch-latency=6ms to maintain p95 target, warm thread-local cache for first 5k requests, surface cold-start separately.

mike-eng: Ops runbook snippet for Ellen to share:

mike-eng: ```
pre-checks: provision KMS keys, validate node IAM and networking
ramp: 0->100 qps in 2m, 100->1k in 10m, hold 30m
burst: inject 5k qps for 120s at minute 40
metrics: collect p50/p95/p99, batch-size and kv-hit histograms, GPU mem pressure
fallback: if sustained errors>1% for 15s route traffic to dedicated, page eng-oncall
post-run: bundle traces + perf profiles + cost estimate inputs
```

harper-legal: I'll append a short note re BAA path and HSM options.

devon-ps: I'll assemble a one-slide summary with cost table, risks (HIPAA/KMS, multi-region tail, cold-start), and expected tail delta. Draft in ~45m.

ellen-sales: Great. Tagging @perf-bot to schedule the sim overnight so we have results in the morning. Anything else?

zoe-sre: Conservative callout: crossing AZs can add ~30-60ms tail. Recommend TLS session reuse and keep warm-fallback thresholds conservative.

mike-eng: Adding tail delta column to cost/risk table.

perf-bot: Run scheduled: job_id=ph-solara-2026-03-21-01. Will post summarized metrics on completion.

ellen-sales: Thanks team, will send exec note after I review the slide. Closing thread for now.
